items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: You and Jabbo worked together in Claude Hopkins' band.

ctx.x: Yeah! Not only was he a musician, he was a writer and everything. And a composer; he wrote some... So he was a pretty good dude.
You and Jabbo worked together in Claude Hopkins' band.
Yes. We were pretty tight friends, you know. Yeah, Jabbo has written several good numbers, and no one has ever tried to do them. I did a couple of them.
